objectives.description: Case (o): COVERAGE_GAP + coverage-gap group into one proposal
Case (p): repeated --tasks exits nonzero, no JSON on stdout
Case (q): scope excursion produces no unknown_classes row
Case (r): fixture issues.jsonl byte-identical before/after aggregate run
Case (s): unrecognized class still appears, no double-count
Case (t): scope excursion and scope omission remain separate

approaches_tried.approach: Case (s) in test-issue-record.sh initially grepped stderr for the literal substring 'class shape' (case-insensitive) to detect the new convention-citing warning.
approaches_tried.reason: the actual warning text says 'Class Value Shape' convention, with 'Value' in between -- 'class shape' is not a substring of 'Class Value Shape', so the grep never matched despite the warning firing correctly. Fixed by grepping for 'class value shape' instead; re-ran and confirmed all three sub-cases pass.

non_vacuous_proof: Every one of the 10 new cases (o,p,q,r,s,t in the aggregate suite; s,t,u in the issue-record suite via sub-assertions, v as a legitimate always-passing control) was independently confirmed to fail against either the pre-fix commit (c8bcc510b/d9326d9c8/4d3b286a3, extracted via git show into a disposable scratch harness) or, for case (r) and (t)'s over-merge direction where no historical commit exhibits the bug, a deliberately bug-injected scratch copy (a rewrite-on-read defect for (r); a populated CLASS_ALIASES_JSON entry collapsing scope omission into scope excursion for (t)). All scratch directories were created under the session scratchpad and removed afterward; none touched the live repo tree.
